title: DuQTTA: Dual Quantized Tensor-Train Adaptation with Decoupling Magnitude-Direction for Efficient Fine-Tuning of LLMs
problem: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods for LLMs struggle to balance accuracy and efficiency at scale, particularly when targeting deployment on resource-constrained edge devices with severe memory and compute limitations.
motivation: LLM deployment on edge devices requires extreme compression while maintaining task-specific performance, necessitating beyond-PEFT innovations combining multiple compression and optimization techniques.
method: DuQTTA combines Tensor-Train decomposition with dual-stage quantization and adaptive optimization strategy with decoupled magnitude-direction updates to minimize model size, achieving up to 65x compression on LLaMA2-7B while improving over LoRA through architectural co-design for edge deployment.
key_novelty: Dual-stage quantization of Tensor-Train components with decoupled magnitude-direction updates for extreme LLM compression without full-parameter fine-tuning.
contributions: DuQTTA method combining Tensor-Train decomposition and dual-stage quantization for LLM compression
Adaptive optimization strategy with decoupled update mechanism for improved performance
Up to 65x compression rate on LLaMA2-7B compared to full model

metrics.accuracy: 4.44% improvement on LLaMA2-7B over LoRA, 3.14% on LLaMA3-8B, 0.97% on LLaMA2-13B

limitations: Not discussed; evaluation limited to QA/instruction-following without exploring full deployment pipeline.
primary_theme: Extreme LLM compression via dual-quantized tensor-train for edge deployment
